verdict.rationale: Whether a hosting platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Netlify's platform, CLI, or SDK source is available under an open license. The CLI and SDK docs say nothing about licensing, and the one 'open source' mention (intdir-11) describes a third-party Svelte framework, not Netlify.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
